basis: FAM-BLAZER-BUILD-004: unsigned build-only recipe for blazer (Pixel 10 Pro) from checked-in pinned sources only. It binds no host: the operator supplies the host label, source root, lock, download and receipt paths, and make jobs at run time, and scripts/blazer-build-only.py admits them. Nothing here was downloaded, generated, compiled, signed or run on any host or phone. Allowances are null until measured on the operator's host; capacity.allowanceRequired is true, so preflight stays not ready until they are.

integration.basis: Compile needs the Rose integration: the newest reconcile receipt in the operator's --integration-dir must be a blazer-labelled receipt from this checkout's trusted patcher that still matches the tree, and must bind to --inputs-receipt (scripts/blazer_integration.py admit over os/build-only/blazer-reconcile.json): the admitted build label and recipe, the installed APK bytes, Launcher3, the routed Updater and the policy pins.

capacity.basis: available - allowance >= reserve on the filesystem holding the source root and download dir. Each allowance must be measured for blazer on the operator's host; null is never estimated and never waived (no isolated-host exception).
